<reason>CON kept the conjunctive motion live: recent switches did not isolate a default-driven surge, and silence-as-permission can wrong patients even if refusal charts stay flat. PRO’s package/clustering story and vivid waitlist weighing were strong, but they never made the consent shift itself the proven lever, and a clipped R1 plus “no complaints = no victims” left the ethics remainder standing.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s reply that a default can mislabel and ethically injure without being the causal engine of transplant rates, which broke PRO’s inert-or-effective dilemma.</best_rebuttal>
